notes: Prompt Atelier V0.6.5 candidate: verified full ZIP backup and pre-update snapshot; persistent 60-second folder auto-monitoring while the workbench is open; browser heartbeat lifecycle shutdown; integrated analysis for 1–8 images with hash-verified source provenance; conservative structured material conflict detection. Approved AI history imports now preserve original prompt/media paths, source SHA-256 hashes, model, analysis ID and import time; case detail view exposes this provenance. Visual asset library now supports selecting multiple visible cases, bulk status changes, bulk tag addition, and confirmed bulk deletion. Failed saves roll back the in-memory state; deletions are retained in the existing per-asset revision history. Reusable prompt modules now support multi-select, bulk tag addition, and confirmed batch deletion with rollback on save failure. Case records now expose a dedicated product SKU/style-number field, include it in local keyword retrieval, and display it in result metadata; exact SKU lookup can now be populated through the normal case editor. Single-case edits and deletions now use UI-side rollback on failed persistence, matching the batch operation safety behavior. Fixed escaped template interpolation in smart case search results and exposed SKU in the case detail view. Case library now captures structured garment silhouette, fit, fabric composition, surface texture, construction details, craftsmanship, and generation constraints for richer retrieval and reuse. AI history analysis now classifies each input image by role (front/back/detail/fabric/label/scene/overall/unknown), preserves ordered per-image observations through human review and case import, and shows the classification in saved case details. Uncertain or missing roles remain explicitly marked for human review. AI history ingestion now extracts a structured outfit_items list (per garment/accessory category, name, color, material, silhouette, fit, details, evidence and bounded review score) plus evidence-backed outfit_relations. AI review and case details preview the breakdown; confirmed cases persist it, and the matcher can find an individual garment inside a complete outfit case. Uncertain item attributes remain review suggestions, not verified facts. Case editor now supports direct manual maintenance of the outfit_items breakdown and explicit outfit_relations using compact per-item fields, preserving AI evidence/review metadata where entries are retained. Smart retrieval now includes an optional browser-local perceptual-hash image shortlist across verified case references. The selected query image is processed in the browser and is not uploaded; the feature is explicitly a coarse near-duplicate/visual-structure aid, not semantic same-garment recognition. It compares at most 500 library images per query and rejects query files over 20MB. Reference-image roles now also retain explicit authority priority (primary/secondary/supporting) and the attributes each reference governs; role-based defaults are conservative, AI suggestions are shown during review, and approved cases preserve these controls for later prompt construction. Case editor now also permits manual correction of each reference image's role, authority priority, governed attributes and observation, with image indexes checked against the number of attached images. Prompt composition can now optionally append the saved outfit-item breakdown and reference-image authority guide. It distinguishes primary/secondary/supporting references, explains governed attributes, and warns that stored asset numbering does not automatically rewrite @image identifiers in the original prompt. Asset history now supports on-demand side-by-side comparison of a retained prompt revision with the current prompt before restoration. Full historical payloads are fetched only when the user clicks compare; the history list remains lightweight. Smart search now accepts local usefulness/mismatch feedback for individual returned cases. Feedback is stored locally with query, case ID, and retrieval score; the settings page aggregates counts and top feedback cases. Feedback is for evaluation only and does not silently alter ranking weights. Reliability hardening now serializes local data saves to prevent out-of-order writes, adds 15–20 second local read/save timeouts and operation-specific API request timeouts (longer for AI analysis), and writes local API diagnostics without request bodies, URLs, or credential-bearing exception text. Case and reusable prompt-module records now support separate optional English prompt text. Detail view and copy controls expose it, and the composer can append available English versions without inventing translations. The composer now offers model-specific general guidance profiles for WAN 3.0, MiniMax H3, and Seedance 2.5, and correctly treats RunningHub as a platform rather than a model. Guidance is optional and explicitly not represented as official model parameters.
